title: Release v0.9.0: fix the tracer that stole its own tracee, and the test that could not fail
summary: Published v0.9.0 at aac09659. Two independent causes of silently wedged concurrent capture sessions were found and fixed: PtraceTracer::wait_event used waitpid(-1, __WALL), which reaps any child of the process rather than of the calling thread, so two tracer threads could steal each other's tracee; and uat_c2_01 read a status literal the product itself produces, so its verdict was circular. Also superseded two wrongly created cycles.
